title: Publish build: cache-bust and deployment verification docs (frontend-only)

requirements.summary: Ensure the deployed frontend serves the latest build reliably (no stale cached bundle) and provide a publish/smoke-check runbook for the live URL verification flow.
acceptanceCriteria: A new deployment is performed for both frontend assets and the backend canister(s), upgrading to the latest source in the repository.
The live application loads without errors and reflects the latest deployed build (no stale cached bundle served).
Basic smoke-check passes on the live deployment: user can load the Dashboard route ('/'), navigate to Race Lobby ('/race'), and authentication via Internet Identity still works.

file_operations.description: Add standard cache-busting/no-cache meta directives (e.g., Cache-Control/Pragma/Expires) to reduce the risk of clients receiving a stale cached bundle after deployment; keep the document structure and app behavior unchanged.

Document the exact publish workflow and post-deploy smoke-check steps focused on: hard-refresh guidance to avoid stale caches, verifying '/' and '/race' routes load, and confirming Internet Identity login/logout works on the live URL; do not introduce new product features or UI changes.
